checks.purchase_evidence: Recent purchasers use physical logs for new-RV, warranty, service and resale records.
checks.need: Owners must turn several manuals, invoices and recall checks into one evidence trail.
checks.discovery_path: RV maintenance log book; RV maintenance handbook; dealer and owner-community recommendation.
checks.accessible_gap: Blank logs record events but do not teach schedule extraction, source capture, warranty evidence or installer questions.
checks.rights_expertise_timing: Source-dependent workflow is feasible using owner-provided manuals and NHTSA; exclude repair instructions and invented intervals; evergreen with light source refresh.

checks.purchase_evidence: Physical fitting books have visible ratings and buyers explicitly seek an easier physical explanation.
checks.need: A solo sewist needs to observe fit symptoms, test one alteration and record the next muslin.
checks.discovery_path: sewing fitting book; pattern fitting book; teacher and sewing-community recommendation.
checks.accessible_gap: Incumbents are comprehensive and often assume a fitting helper; a self-fitting triage sequence may be more usable.
checks.rights_expertise_timing: Original or licensed instructional photography and specialist review are material requirements; full-color economics are harder.

checks.purchase_evidence: First-time growers ask for books and established allotment references sell in the expected price band.
checks.need: Sequence the first year without an encyclopedic decision burden.
checks.discovery_path: allotment planner; allotment book for beginners; community recommendation.
checks.accessible_gap: The low-overwhelm scenario is credible but not yet shown to outperform trusted RHS and bestselling month-by-month incumbents.
checks.rights_expertise_timing: UK-specific horticultural accuracy and calendar variation require deeper expertise; evergreen but seasonal.

checks.concept: State-Specific CDL Pre-Trip Oral Rehearsal Book
checks.purchase_evidence: Current independent supply exists, but visible newcomer traction was not established.
checks.need: Candidates can know the content yet fail to verbalize the inspection sequence.
checks.discovery_path: CDL pre trip study guide; state CDL oral pre-trip; training-school recommendation.
checks.accessible_gap: Oral rehearsal is specific, but free state manuals, videos and apps are strong and rules vary by state.
checks.rights_expertise_timing: Requires state-by-state official-source QA and update monitoring; no clear autonomous low-cost scope.

checks.purchase_evidence: A workbook has modest visible ratings and a specialist citation sheet sells for $9.99.
checks.need: Turn each family-history claim into a traceable source, conflict note and next action.
checks.discovery_path: genealogy research workbook; genealogy citation guide; specialist-store recommendation.
checks.accessible_gap: The exact narrow job is already served by paid specialist and free authority materials; superiority is unproven.
checks.rights_expertise_timing: Original workflow is feasible, but genealogical citation standards and expert credibility raise QA cost.
